thread:
mari: quick heads up — seeing a perf regression on gqa-4b after the kvcache layout change (paged-kv interleaving). ~12% p95 increase at seqlen 2048 on A100. cc @rahul @anya
perf-bot: profile summary:
```
model: gqa-4b
hw: a100-sxm4
seqlen: 2048
mode: infer (batched)
path: gqa -> paged-kv (interleaved) -> mqa/gqa-kernels
p95: +12% vs baseline
hotspots: memcpy (18%), kernel-launch overhead (12%), aten::gather-like (8%)
```
rahul: can you paste the nsys call you used and the kernel selection logs? want to see if we're hitting a different kernel path or just more launches
mari: ran with:
```
nsys profile -o run.nsys --force --capture-range=nvtx --nvtx=range --trace=cuda,osrt ./serve --model gqa-4b --seqlen 2048 --batch 8
cat kernel-select.log | grep "kernel_path"
```
mari: kernel-select.log excerpt:
"model=gqa-4b seqlen=2048 chosen_path=pagedkv_interleaved block_size=64 mapping=packed kernel_variant=GQA_PAGED_BLOCK_V2"
anya: two quick suspicions: 1) the interleaved mapping increases strided memcpy because of the packed layout, 2) block_size 64 crosses a threshold that forces extra prep kernels for MQA/GQA dispatch. did you try larger block_size? :thinking:
tj: i noticed in last scheduler PR we added an extra per-block kernel to handle cache-fragment merges for packed mapping — that will multiply launches for small blocks. try block_size=128 or switch mapping to "stripe" to reduce fragmentation.
kevin: repro'd locally on A100-80GB. results:
- baseline (old layout): p95 84ms
- new interleaved packed block_size=64: p95 94ms (+12%)
- interleaved stripe block_size=64: p95 90ms (+7%)
- interleaved packed block_size=128: p95 86.5ms (+3%)
So bumping block_size to 128 or switching mapping to stripe recovers most of the lost perf.
rahul: nice. so two paths: revert layout change OR teach kernel selector to prefer stripe/128 for seqlen>=1024. which is safer short-term?
mari: short-term: add a selector override rule: if model_type in {gqa, mqa} and seqlen >= 1024 then mapping=stripe or block_size>=128. medium-term: we should refactor the packed->merge kernel to avoid extra launches. I'll open a follow-up.
perf-bot: created ticket PERF-2026: Investigate paged-kv interleaving regression — https://redwood.example/t/PERF-2026 (assignee: tj)
kevin: I'll run a 24h soak with block_size=128 stripe mapping and post traces. if soak looks good we can roll the selector override as hotfix.
anya: also add an eval check for output parity when switching mapping — subtle order changes sometimes show up in downstream sampling.
mari: agreed. thanks all — adding to sprint board and assigning follow-ups. :thumbsup:
